tasks.name: NovelAI 指定楼层生图
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
(async () => {
    const FLOOR0 = 4440;
    const FLOOR = FLOOR0 + 1;

    const mod = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/draw/providers/novelai/novel-draw.js');
    const { getContext } = await import('/scripts/extensions.js');

    const ctx = getContext();
    const chat = ctx.chat || [];
    if (!chat.length) { window.toastr?.error('当前没有聊天记录'); return; }

    const messageId = FLOOR - 1;
    const msg = chat[messageId];
    if (!msg) { window.toastr?.error(`楼层 ${FLOOR0} 不存在`); return; }
    if (!String(msg.mes || '').trim()) {
        window.toastr?.error(`楼层 ${FLOOR0} 内容为空`);
        return;
    }

    window.toastr?.info(`开始为楼层 ${FLOOR0} 生图...`);

    try {
        const result = await mod.generateAndInsertImages({
            messageId,
            onStateChange: (state, data) => {
                console.log(`[DrawFloor] ${state}`, data || {});
            },
        });
        console.log('[DrawFloor] 完成:', result);
        window.toastr?.success(`✅ 楼层 ${FLOOR0} 生图完成`);
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('[DrawFloor] 完整错误:', e);
        console.error('[DrawFloor] code:', e?.code, 'status:', e?.status);
        console.error('[DrawFloor] errorType:', e?.errorType);
        window.toastr?.error(`楼层 ${FLOOR0} 生图失败: ${e?.message || e}`);
    }
})();
<</taskjs>>
